Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Noah Round Modern Ash Dining Table, 35.4"W, White
Colors: White
Materials: MDF
This modern, sleek round table is small enough to fit in a number of places and easy to move, yet with its solid ash legs, it can endure steady use. It can fit in with a simple decor or be spruced up to go with different rooms or occasions. 35.4"W x 35.4"D x 30"H Solid ash legs and white MDF tabletop with a natural finish This round, modern dining table is easy to carry and clean and can fit in nearly any room. It can be used for meals or a number of other purposes. The ash legs and white tabletop create a stylish but clean modern look. Its ageless design blends with its surroundings. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Using a soft, damp cloth, wipe in the direction of the grain. Free returns for 30 days; 1-year warranty.
